title: ever EVERLAINE|Halter Neck Pleated Glittery Formal Evening Dress with Empire Waist
descriptionHtml:
Turn heads in this glittery halter neck evening gown that beautifully defines the shoulders and waist. The soft pleated bodice and flowy A-line silhouette create a slimming, elongating effect for all body shapes. Perfect for wedding guests, proms, or formal dinners, this gown brings timeless elegance with just the right touch of sparkle.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
